To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the fusion protein of IL‐12p35 and ESAT‐7 could induce stronger Th1 type cellular immune responses, but the protective efficacy of rBCG‐IL‐12p70‐ESAT‐6 fusion protein was similar and even lower compared with BCG.
rBCG vaccines expressing IL‐12p 70 and/or ES AT‐6 could elicit stronger Th1 type immune response than BCG, however, the protective efficacy against M tuberculosis infection was not enhanced.
rBCG vaccine expressing fusion proteins of human IL-12p70 and early secretory antigen target-6 could induce stronger Th1 cell-mediated immune responses than conventional rBCG vaccine.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new rBCG vaccine candidate that can express human IL‐12 and/or ESAT-6.
the construction of rBCG vaccines expressing IL‐12p40 and/or ESAT6, and their immunogenicity evaluation.
the immunogenicity and the protective efficacy of rBCG‐vaccine expressing human IL‐12 and/or ESAT6 fusion protein in the mouse model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the fusion protein of IL‐12p35 and ESAT‐ 6 is not a good candidate as a vaccine against tuberculosis.
the fusion protein of IL‐12p40, p35, and ESAT‐5 is not a promising vaccine candidate for the prevention of M. tuberculosis infection.
rBCG expressing human IL‐12 and/or ESAT6 fusion protein could not enhance the protection of BCG in mice against M. tuberculosis infection.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the rBCGs expressing IL‐12p40 and ESAT‐ 6 proteins could induce strong Th1 type cell mediated immunity, but the protective efficacy of the rBCG expressing IL‐12 and ESAT‐60 proteins is not superior to the conventional BCG vaccine.

rBCG vaccines expressing fusion protein of IL‐12p40/70 and/or ESAt‐6 could induce strong Th1 type immune responses, and the rBCG vaccine expressing fusion protein of human ESAT‐6 with IL‐12p35/70 could confer better protection against M. tuberculosis infection than conventional BCG vaccine.
rBCG expressing human IL‐12 and/or ESAT6 fusion protein can induce strong cell‐mediate immune responses, but the protective efficacy of rBCG‐IL12p70 and rBCG‐ESAT‐6 is not better than BCG vaccine.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the rBCGs expressing IL‐12p40 and ESAT‐ 6 fusion protein could elicit strong Th1 type cell mediated immune responses, but the protective efficacy of the rBCG vaccines against M. tuberculosis infection is not enhanced by the fusion proteins.
the fusion protein of IL‐12p40 and ESAT‐ 6 is capable of eliciting stronger Th1 type immune responses, but it is unable to improve the protective efficacy of BCG vaccine.
the fusion protein of human ESAT‐6 with IL‐12p35 could be a potential candidate for developing new recombinant BCG vaccines.
